name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.45.0: Draw every positioned node the session holds; Give the range test a scan to read, and the grace a reconnect; Auto-connect to the radio you have, not the one BlueZ remembers.
changelog.v2.44.0: Draw the map, and record what steps 1 and 2 became; Put the nodes and the places on a map; Project a coordinate onto a flat picture of the world; Keep the map's presses and its ink inside the map.
changelog.v2.43.1: Date a press's toast by the clock driving the frames; Say why a new waypoint cannot be made.
changelog.v2.43.0: Explain the long tail of settings rows; Stop a help topic falling back across a subheading.
changelog.v2.42.0: Explain the features as well as the settings; Ask the route whether a settings section is what is on the panel.
